transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to determine true transmissibility and severity before deciding on costlier interventions.

actions.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to determine true transmissibility and severity before deciding on costlier interventions.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: We cannot wait for supply-chain shortages to materialize; start scaling PPE, tests, and ventilators now while industry still has lead time.

actions.rationale: We cannot wait for supply-chain shortages to materialize; start scaling PPE, tests, and ventilators now while industry still has lead time.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Markets and the public are spooked by uncertainty; steady, data-driven daily leadership will build trust and reduce panic-driven volatility.

actions.rationale: Markets and the public are spooked by uncertainty; steady, data-driven daily leadership will build trust and reduce panic-driven volatility.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A single transparent federal data source will cut through rumor, align state and private-sector planning, and let the public see facts in real time.

actions.rationale: A single transparent federal data source will cut through rumor, align state and private-sector planning, and let the public see facts in real time.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need standby funding and statutory authorities now so we can move fast later without legislative delays if the virus worsens.

actions.rationale: We need standby funding and statutory authorities now so we can move fast later without legislative delays if the virus worsens.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: This is a low-cost, high-upside early measure we can implement immediately in federal spaces while urging states to adopt a national standard.

actions.rationale: This is a low-cost, high-upside early measure we can implement immediately in federal spaces while urging states to adopt a national standard.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Until we know how deadly this is, focusing protection on the elderly and high-risk groups lets us slow mortality without a premature total shutdown.

actions.rationale: Until we know how deadly this is, focusing protection on the elderly and high-risk groups lets us slow mortality without a premature total shutdown.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.7 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.
